svg.title: Two complete prepared D assemblies under motion and imposed release
svg.text: Two complete D-shaped assemblies with identical curved W blocks
Actual geometry | seed 761 | 16 solver passes | purple: temporary copying-face bonds
Each half: P-A-A-Q plus eight W wedges. Four conserved free E blocks are outside these cropped panels.
Both arcs and chains are prepared. Four copying-face bonds are removed experimentally after t40.
This tests shape and separation; it does not show autonomous growth, replication or a sealed protective wall.
